name: Gobbles fruit cake
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), EGG, SUGAR, VANASPATI, FRUIT PRODUCTS (7.4%) (GLAZED FRUITS (PAPAYA CUTS, SUGAR, PRESERVATIVE (202) AND COLOURS (124 & 110)} AND ORANGE PULP), INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, HUMECTANT (422), REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, LIQUID GLUCOSE, DEXTROSE, HIGH MALTOSE SYRUP, FRUCTOOLIGOSACCHARIDES, CAKE GEL [EMULSIFIERS (471, 477,470(i)) & HUMECTANTS (1520,422)], EDIBLE MAIZE STARCH, WHEAT STARCH, RAISING AGENTS (341(i), 500(ii), 450(vii) & 450(i)), NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (MIXED FRUIT AND CREAMY VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, IODIZED SALT, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, PRESERVATIVES (202& 282), ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), BAKING POWDER, EMULSIFIER (475), STABILIZER (415) AND COLOUR (102).
